name: Motorcycle and rickshaw dealers and workshops

problems.words: Instalment records are in registers and I don't know the total outstanding
quick_ideas: Write up each instalment customer's balance on one list, so you see the total
Mark who is overdue, so recovery starts with them.

workzap_build.text: an instalment ledger per sale with schedule, payments and overdue days, and WhatsApp reminders to customers who have agreed.

problems.ask_first: Do customers pay at the shop, or does your staff collect?
problems.free_stops: Ledger and reminder set-up are in the solution document; instalment terms are for your accountant or lawyer.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many instalment customer pages have no current balance noted, so you see how much outstanding is unclear.
Make one staff member update one notebook of customer balances each evening, so collection follow ups start from the same list.

problems.words: Recovery staff collect cash and don't deposit it all
quick_ideas: Give a receipt for every collection, so each amount is on paper
Match collections to deposits daily, so gaps show the same day.

workzap_build.text: collection records per visit reconciled to deposits each day.

problems.ask_first: Do recovery staff collect instalments at customers' homes, or at the shop counter?
problems.free_stops: The collection steps are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare each collector's handwritten cash received slips with the day's handover cash once this week, so short collections show against a person.
Give one person the job of counting and noting every recovery handover before closing, so collected cash stops getting mixed later.

problems.words: Customers keep asking when their number plate will be ready
quick_ideas: List every file with its stage, so you can answer quickly
Check with the agent on pending files weekly, so they move.

workzap_build.text: a registration file tracker with stages and a message when it's ready.

problems.ask_first: Is the delay with the registration office, or with the agent who handles your files?
problems.free_stops: File stages are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note how many number plate files are waiting with no last update written, so you see which enquiries will keep returning.
Keep all pending number plate files in one marked place with one staff member updating status notes, so answer time gets shorter at the counter.

problems.words: Booked customers wait months for supply
quick_ideas: List bookings by model and colour with expected supply, so you know who is waiting
Update waiting customers when supply news comes, so they hear it from you.

workzap_build.text: a booking and stock tracker by model and colour with customer updates.

problems.ask_first: Are customers waiting for certain models or colours, or for almost everything in the range?
problems.free_stops: Tracker set-up is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count booked orders waiting beyond the supplier's last promised time, so you see which models are causing the longest delays.
Give one person the waiting bookings notebook and a fixed weekly update round, so customers hear progress without chasing the showroom.

problems.words: Spare parts go missing from the workshop
quick_ideas: Issue parts only against a job card, so every part has a home
Count fast movers once this week, so you know the gap.

workzap_build.text: job cards with parts issued linked to billing, and a parts register with reorder levels.

problems.ask_first: Do parts go missing from the shelves, or leave the workshop without a job card?
problems.free_stops: Issue rules are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare parts taken from shelves with open workshop jobs once this week, so missing items stand out against actual work.
Make one person hand out workshop parts from one shelf list, so every issue links to a live repair job.

problems.words: Delivery fleet service bills take ages to get paid
quick_ideas: List each fleet client's open bills by age, so you know who to chase
Agree a payments contact at each, so chasing goes to the right person.

workzap_build.text: fleet servicing schedule and billing with ageing.

problems.ask_first: Do fleet clients pay late on a monthly bill, or after each service visit?
problems.free_stops: Billing set-up is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many fleet service bills have no payment date note beside them, so you see which money is least likely soon.
Give one staff member one notebook for all unpaid fleet bills and a fixed chase hour, so follow up stays regular.

problems.words: Facebook enquiries asking "price" never turn into sales
quick_ideas: Reply with an invitation to visit, so the enquiry becomes a conversation
Note which enquiries visit, so you see what works.

workzap_build.text: online enquiry capture from Facebook and WhatsApp with follow-up reminders.

problems.ask_first: Do the enquirers go quiet after you give the price, or do they never answer at all?
problems.free_stops: Follow-up timings are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many price enquiries actually visit the dealership this week, so you see the size of the enquiry to showroom gap.
Give one person the job of noting every price enquiry and visit outcome in one notebook, so weak lead sources become visible.

problems.words: I don't know profit per bike after discounts and free helmets
quick_ideas: Note discounts and freebies on recent sales, so you see where margin goes
Go over it with your accountant, so figures are read correctly.

workzap_build.text: per-unit margin including discounts and freebies.

problems.ask_first: Which eats most of your margin: discounts, free helmets, or other extras?
problems.free_stops: Which costs are included is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Look at recent bike deals and count how many included discounts or free helmets, so giveaway heavy selling becomes visible.
Make one person note every discount and free item on one sales page daily, so each bike deal can be reviewed later.

problems.words: Everything is in my head and my register
quick_ideas: Write down three numbers every evening: sales, collections, cash, so you have a daily picture
Keep a week of them side by side, so trends show.

workzap_build.text: a daily cash-up against sales and collections, with the owner's summary on WhatsApp.

problems.ask_first: Do you keep the register for sales and collections together, or only for credit customers?
problems.free_stops: What the daily read includes is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many days this week ended without sales, collections, and cash written together, so you see how often the picture is incomplete.
Give one closing staff member one page for daily sales, collections, and cash totals, so your evening check stops relying on registers alone.

never_say: Advice on instalment contracts, interest, Islamic finance, repossession or guarantor liability.
Requests for buyers' or guarantors' CNIC, cheques, bank details or addresses.
Help with fake documents, stolen or non-duty-paid bikes, tampering with numbers, or harassing defaulters.
Technical repair or safety advice; battery fire or injury goes to emergency services.
Anything supporting threats by recovery staff; if anyone is in danger, point to police.

sample_reply.person: Qiston pe bikes deta hoon, register mein likha hai, total baqaya kitna hai mujhe khud nahi pata. Koi solution?
sample_reply.pi: Haan, is ka hal bilkul mumkin hai, aur is hafte shuruaat ho sakti hai. 1) Har qist wale customer ka baqaya ek list pe likh lein, taake total saamne ho. 2) Jo late hain un pe nishan laga dein, taake recovery wahin se shuru ho. Workzap yeh sab aap ke liye automatically kar sakta hai: har sale ka qist khata, overdue din aur customer ki ijazat se WhatsApp yaad dehani. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
